arguments.command: cd $CLONE && wc -l README.md && grep -n '^#' README.md | head -60 && grep -n -i 'tune' README.md | head -30
cd $CLONE && grep -rln -i 'tune' yf/src | head -20; ls docs 2>/dev/null | head -30
cd $CLONE && ls docs/yf; grep -rn -i 'tune' docs/yf docs/recommended-settings.md | head -30; ls target/debug/yf target/release/yf 2>&1
cd $CLONE && which yf; yf --version; yf harness tune --help 2>&1 | head -80
